rows.corpus_definition: To say that something is good and worth having.
rows.example_en: I recommend this book to everyone.

rows.corpus_definition: to become healthy again after being sick or hurt
rows.example_en: It took him a week to recover from the flu.

rows.corpus_definition: Turning old items into new materials to use again.
rows.example_en: Recycling helps to keep our streets and parks clean.

rows.corpus_definition: To make someone feel less tired or hot.
rows.example_en: A cold drink will refresh you.

rows.corpus_definition: A person who is part of your family.
rows.example_en: I invited all my relations to the wedding.

rows.corpus_definition: The way two people or groups feel and act toward each other.
rows.example_en: They have a very strong relationship.

rows.corpus_definition: a feeling of comfort when worry or pain goes away
rows.example_en: She felt great relief when she heard the good news.

rows.corpus_definition: To trust that someone will help you.
rows.example_en: You can rely on my help.

rows.corpus_definition: To help someone remember something they might forget.
rows.example_en: Please remind me to call my mother.

rows.corpus_definition: To pay money to use something that belongs to someone else.
rows.example_en: We pay rent for our apartment every month.
